Working notes, technical examples, and reflections on statistics, actuarial science, data visualisation, and learning through practice.

These pages collect individual ideas and analytical examples. My [*Notes on Data and Learning* newsletter](../newsletter/index.qmd) brings together broader reflections and updates on Substack.

## Explore the notes

- [Statistics and R](posts/stats/) — modelling, prediction, Bayesian statistics, and practical analytical workflows.
- [Data visualisation](posts/dataviz/) — maps, networks, public health examples, and visual storytelling.
- [Actuarial science](posts/actuarial/) — risk, modelling, and professional practice.
- [Automation and analytical projects](../proj/) — practical workflow notes and health metrics examples.

Some posts document earlier projects. Dates and original examples are retained as part of that record.
